title: Matte White Collection - Elevated!
bodyHtml:
Manhattan Series now On-Demand in Stunning Matte White

This week our On-Demand Matte White Collection gets an upgrade with the addition of our best selling toilet series - The Manhattan, now in-stock and ready to ship in gorgeous Matte White!

Renowned for its sleek architectural lines and soft curves, Manhattan is now available in stunning matte white, giving you even more freedom to introduce a timeless and tactile finish into your bathroom.

In-Stock & Ready to Ship Matte White

The best part? Our entire matte white collection is in stock and ready to ship immediately, eliminating the usual lead times associated with coloured products meaning its never been simpler to elevate your bathroom’s aesthetic.

In Stock & Ready to Ship

Upgrade your bathroom with the sophistication of matte white!

Click the button below to learn more about our Matte White Manhattan range as well as the extensive Matte White collection or call us at (02) 9601 1948 to organize a viewing.

Explore the Matte White Collection

Download our complete 2024 Collection Catalogue

This edition of our catalog marks a significant shift in how we present our products. Discover thoughtfully curated sets that bring together essential bathroom components—basins, toilets, baths, and in-wall cisterns.

Plus explore an expansive range of New Baths, New Matte White Collection, a swathe of brand new product lines, a return of pricing and so much more!
